reviews.title: Would do zero stars if optional
reviews.text: I used to LOVE this app, it was fun and interactive, I loved being able to make my own horror text stories. I went to download it again for the nostalgia and now you need to pay $10 a week to even access it? That is the most insane ask I’ve ever seen from an app. You also offer a free 1 week trial, but when I went to use the free week it automatically tried to charge my card? (Luckily my card is locked when not in use) this is so sad to see. I hate seeing apps that I loved as a teen get so money hungry. You didn’t need to do that, and you knew it. This is unfortunate, and I hope you’re reading these reviews and taking them into deep consideration.

reviews.title: $9.99 a week?
reviews.text: I remember when this app was completely free to use. I decided to redownload it because I had not used it in a few years and figured why not. After seeing that I had to pay to even get to any stories I deleted the app again. I did go and read some other reviews and am glad I did not opt to pay because I suppose there is a huge increase of AI stories and I do not superhero use of AI. I just wanted my cute free story app back but I guess companies just like being greedy with money than actually keeping their apps the same when all users initially enjoyed them.
